tests.counting_note: Only final successful runs are counted. The initial 26-test SDK run is a subset of the 441-case suite and is not added again.

mypy.scope_note: Targeted checking, not the complete repository type-check suite.

test_driven_fixes: Updated the event-query budget to include the unchanged legacy XCom join: four DagRun-related queries.
Updated the missing-DagRun regression mock to target the new execute-based query, preserving the real 404 assertion.
Avoided a measured task-decoder allocation increase by using key-cached Pydantic-core parsing followed by typed root validation.
Added a narrowly scoped annotation for Pydantic's callable validator descriptor after targeted mypy reported its static type.

memory_benchmark.method: Fresh processes measure actual PostgreSQL JSONB driver retrieval, Airflow model serialization, SDK parsing and MessagePack IPC. One and four retained starts simulate overlap within each isolated phase.
memory_benchmark.task_configuration_equality: Identical canonical SHA256 for baseline and patched task configurations in all measured cases.
tradeoffs: The collection loader intentionally adds one database query to avoid repeating the large JSON text for every consumed asset event.
The isolated task phase retains a small allocation increase, about two percent in the four-start case.
Native JSON-root type checking adds database work; its invalid-input rollback tests passed on all three backends.
limitations: This is an isolated phase benchmark, not a live HTTP-server, Celery or pod-RSS load test.
Four retained starts are not the planned 20-concurrent-DagRun ADME test.
Do not sum independently measured phase peaks as a production pod peak.
No guarantee of regression-free behavior is inferred from these targeted tests.

remaining_validation: Same-instance Helm baseline/patched/baseline ingestion test with 20 concurrent DagRuns and 23000 records per run.
Full production-image and live pod memory/startup-latency validation.
Explicit supported rolling-deployment and rollback behavior for the actual ADME chart.
SQLite non-finite numeric handling remains outside the demonstrated normal-JSON parity cases.
